meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: 它把有先后依赖的任务拆成节点图(节点用 dependsOn 指定先完成哪些),按依赖分层并行跑子任务。单个节点失败可单独重试、发消息或改定义,已完成节点的结果会复用;每次只处理一个阶段的图。
howto.when: 当你提出 mass-ulw、任务 DAG,或存在真实依赖的分批并行工作(如任务 C 需等 A、B 完成)时触发;完全独立的任务用普通并行 task 即可。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次重构拆成有依赖关系的任务图并跑起来
say.note: 会先读 planning.md 再建图启动

say.text: 重试这个 run 里失败的 lint 节点
say.note: 已完成节点结果保留,不重跑

say.text: 给正在跑的 rewrite 节点发消息:跳过 vendored 目录

howto.what_en: It turns dependency-ordered work into a node graph (nodes list dependsOn) and runs child tasks in parallel waves; one bad node can be retried, sent a message, or amended, and finished nodes keep cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or staged fan-out where some tasks must wait on others; fully independent work is simpler with plain parallel tasks.

say_en.text: Turn this refactor into a dependency-ordered task graph with mass-ulw and run it
say_en.note: Reads planning.md first, then starts the run

say_en.text: Retry the failed lint node in this run
say_en.note: Finished nodes keep their cached results

say_en.text: Send the running rewrite node a message: skip the vendored dir
